result.plan:
{"how": "1. Gather resources:
   • Collect wooden logs (any tree species works).
   • Convert logs into wooden planks.
   • Craft sticks from planks if not already available.

2. Acquire metal ore (if making a stone or iron axe):
   • Mine cobblestone or iron ore depending on desired durability.
   • Smelt ore in a furnace to obtain ingots.

3. Build the crafting table (if needed):
   • Place four wooden planks in a square pattern in your inventory crafting grid.

4. Create the axe recipe based on material:
   • Wooden Axe: place three planks vertically in the middle column and two sticks horizontally across the top row’s left and right slots.
   • Stone/Iron Axe: replace the central plank with a stone block or iron ingot respectively while keeping stick positions unchanged.

5. Retrieve crafted axe:
   • Drag it out of the result slot into your hotbar.

6. Optional upgrades:
   • Enchant the axe for extra damage or efficiency.
   • Apply potions or enchantments such as Sharpness, Efficiency, Unbreaking, or Mending.", "what": "Craft a functional axe suitable for chopping trees, mining blocks, or combat.", "why": "This method follows standard survival-game mechanics ensuring resource efficiency and optimal tool performance."}
